subject: Insurance
title: COBRA: Temporary Bridge Coverage
description: Learn COBRA: Temporary Bridge Coverage in one minute.

hook.text: Lose your job? COBRA lets you keep your employer's insurance for 18 months.

buildup.text: Employers paid most of the premium while you worked. On COBRA, you pay 100% plus a 2% admin fee. The cost is shocking.

discovery.text: Only about 10% of eligible people choose COBRA. Most can't afford it right after losing their income.

twist.text: COBRA was passed in 1985 as a safety net, but it only works if you can afford it. For most.

climax.text: COBRA reveals the true cost of employer insurance. You never knew how much it cost until you had to pay it yourself.

punchline.text: $650 a month after losing your job. COBRA's safety net has a steep price tag.

quiz.question: Why do most people decline COBRA coverage?
options: The full premium cost is unaffordable after job loss
